title: Common convergent subsequence for countably many bounded real sequences (diagonal extraction)
statement: Let ι be a countable type, b : ι → ℕ → ℝ and M : ι → ℝ with |b_k(i)| ≤ M_k for all k and i. Then there is a strictly increasing σ : ℕ → ℕ such that for every k the sequence i ↦ b_k(σ(i)) converges in ℝ.
lean_statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Countable ι] (b : ι → ℕ → ℝ) (M : ι → ℝ), (∀ k i, |b k i| ≤ M k) → ∃ σ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono σ ∧ ∀ k, ∃ L : ℝ, Tendsto (fun i => b k (σ i)) atTop (𝓝 L)
